name: spendwise
description: Personal expense tracker and budget management system

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.test:server: node scripts/firebase.mjs emulators:exec --project demo-spendwise --only auth,firestore "npm run test -w server"
scripts.test:browser: node scripts/firebase.mjs emulators:exec --project demo-spendwise --only auth,firestore "node tests/browser.mjs"
